title: QwenGyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Training xLong-Horizon Agents
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake extreme-long (xlong) horizon tasks, where a single execution can span hours, hundreds of model--environment interactions, and nearly 1M tokens per rollout. Applying online reinforcement learning (RL) to such executions poses two fundamental challenges: (1) severe execution variance and prolonged rollout delays cause massive GPU idling; and (2) complex non-linear branching generates massive trajectory redundancy, crippling training efficiency. To address these, we presents QwenGyre, an end-to-end framework for xlong-horizon online RL. QwenGyre elastically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training without interrupting live executions, while its trajectory processor reconstructs branching histories, scores partial progress, and deduplicates redundant paths to bound training costs. Scaled to our flagship model, Qwen~3.8 2.4T, with 700K tokens per rollout, QwenGyre yields a 6.0% absolute gain on NL2RepoBench (52.5% $\to$ 58.5%) in 48 steps. Across our evaluations on diverse domains of training datasets, QwenGyre delivers up to $1.85\times$ and $1.78\times$ speedups over Colocate and Async, respectively.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical course called Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods, today’s lecture is on Qwen Gyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for XLong-Horizon Agents. Work such as Compaction R-L and Polar: Agentic R-L on Any Harness at Scale reflects a shift toward training agents on extended, tool-mediated tasks. This paper, from Alibaba Token Hub with contributors also affiliated with the University of Science and Technology of China, focuses on the infrastructure needed to train those agents efficiently. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门假设叫深度强化学习方法的课上，今天讲的是Qwen Gyre：一个面向超长时程智能体的弹性强化学习框架。Compaction R-L和Polar：Agentic R-L on Any Harness at Scale这类工作，反映出一种转向：在更长的、由工具介导的任务上训练智能体。这篇论文来自阿里巴巴Token Hub，贡献者也有中国科学技术大学的隶属关系，聚焦的是高效训练这类智能体所需的基础设施。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, what makes these tasks different from ordinary long-context generation?
segments.zh: 教授您好，这些任务和普通的长上下文生成有什么不同？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The agent must do more than produce a long answer. It may make hundreds of dependent model and tool calls, maintain workspace state, recover from errors, and delegate subtasks. A typical execution can span several hours and use roughly 700,000 to 1 million tokens. The challenge is therefore partly about reasoning, but also about keeping expensive hardware productive while executions vary widely in duration.
segments.zh: 智能体要做的远不止生成一个长答案。它可能要发起数百次相互依赖的模型调用和工具调用，维护工作区状态，从错误中恢复，还要分派子任务。一次典型的执行可能持续好几个小时，消耗大约70万到100万个token。因此，这个挑战一部分在于推理，但同样在于：当每次执行的时长差异很大时，如何让昂贵的硬件始终保持高效运转。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Qwen Gyre combines two ideas: elastic scheduling of G-P-U resources and structured processing of branching trajectories. In conventional setups, hardware is either shared between rollout and training in alternating stages or divided into fixed pools. Long, unpredictable executions make both arrangements wasteful. Qwen Gyre lets resources change roles as work becomes ready, while preserving the agent’s active environment and its execution history.
segments.zh: Qwen Gyre结合了两个思路：GPU资源的弹性调度和对分支轨迹的结构化处理。在传统配置中，硬件要么在轨迹和训练之间交替分阶段共享，要么被划分为固定资源池。漫长且不可预测的执行让这两种安排都很浪费。Qwen Gyre让资源随着工作就绪而改变角色，同时保留智能体活跃的环境及其执行历史。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does changing a G-P-U’s role interrupt an agent that is already working?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：改变GPU的角色会打断已经在工作的智能体吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. The system reroutes active model requests between inference engines rather than terminating the agent’s execution. The sandbox, tools, workspace, and harness state remain outside those G-P-U workers. Think of it like moving a live phone call between network towers: the connection changes underneath, but the conversation continues. That separation lets the scheduler reassign compute without asking the agent to restart its task.
segments.zh: 不会。系统会在推理引擎之间重新路由正在进行的模型请求，而不是终止智能体的执行。沙箱、工具、工作区和运行框架的状态都保留在这些GPU工作节点之外。可以把它想象成在基站之间切换一通正在进行的电话：底层连接变了，但对话仍在继续。正是这种分离让调度器能够重新分配算力，而无需让智能体重启任务。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The second idea addresses branching histories. Long-running harnesses may compact context, create sub-agent conversations, or retry failed paths. Simply treating every resulting path as an independent sample repeats shared prefixes and can overemphasize heavily branched executions. Qwen Gyre records each model call with its true conditioning context, then reconstructs a tree. Shared context is represented once, and outputs are not attached to messages that appeared only later or in another branch.
segments.zh: 第二个想法解决的是分支历史的问题。长时间运行的执行框架可能会压缩上下文、创建子智能体对话，或者重试失败的路径。如果只是把每条由此产生的路径当作独立样本，就会重复共享前缀，还可能过度强调分支繁多的执行过程。Qwen Gyre 会记录每次模型调用及其真实的上下文条件，然后重建一棵树。共享上下文只表示一次，输出不会挂到那些后来才出现或属于另一分支的消息上。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify how the system decides which branches actually contribute to training?
segments.zh: 你能说明一下系统是如何决定哪些分支真正参与训练的吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: At training admission, it selects up to 5 trajectories per execution, prioritizing main-agent task paths before summaries and sub-agent paths. Only tokens generated by the policy are training targets; prompts, tool replies, and injected content remain context but are masked from the loss. If paths share policy-generated tokens, those targets count once. This keeps branch-rich executions from dominating simply because they produced more paths.
segments.zh: 训练准入时，每次执行最多选5条轨迹，优先选主智能体的任务路径，然后是摘要和子智能体路径。只有策略生成的token才是训练目标；提示、工具回复和注入内容保留为上下文，但在损失中被掩码。如果多条路径共享策略生成的token，这些目标只计一次。这样可避免分支多的执行仅因产生更多路径而占据主导。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The training setup samples 16 independent executions for each query and uses group-relative reinforcement learning, so it does not need a separate value model. Ready trajectory groups enter a shared queue as micro-steps; available training cells claim them as they arrive. A core cell maintains the authoritative weights and optimizer state, while satellite cells can join training when enough rollout work has finished, then return to rollout after an update burst.
segments.zh: 训练设置对每个查询采样16次独立执行，并采用组相对强化学习，因此不需要单独的价值模型。就绪的轨迹组以微步形式进入共享队列；可用的训练单元在它们到达时领取。一个核心单元维护权威权重和优化器状态，而卫星单元可以在足够多的轨迹工作完成后加入训练，并在一次更新爆发后返回轨迹生成。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That elastic arrangement responds to the long tail of execution times. The scheduler tracks unfinished work and shifts cells only when the remaining rollout capacity can still serve active requests. Across 48 steps on the smaller tested model and repository benchmark, Qwen Gyre runs about 1.42 to 1.53 times faster than a fixed asynchronous setup and 1.36 to 1.47 times faster than a fully alternating setup. Training-score curves remain comparable.
segments.zh: 这种弹性安排能应对执行时间的长尾分布。调度器会跟踪未完成的工作，只有当剩余轨迹容量仍能服务活跃请求时，才会转移计算单元。在较小测试模型和代码仓库基准上跑48步，Qwen Gyre比固定异步方案快约1.42到1.53倍，比完全交替方案快1.36到1.47倍。训练得分曲线保持相当。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hold on, do those speed gains come with a quality tradeoff or depend on a particular cluster size?
segments.zh: 等等，这些速度提升会带来质量上的取舍吗，还是说取决于特定的集群规模？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The reported score curves are comparable for those scheduling comparisons, and the larger model’s repository evaluation pass rate rises from 52.48% to 58.54%. But the evidence is tied to large clusters with enough G-P-Us to form viable cells; substantially smaller budgets were not tested. The authors also find that a cap of 5 trajectories preserves scores similar to using all paths while cutting average forward-and-backward time by 25.2%.
segments.zh: 在那些调度对比中，报告的分数曲线是可比的，而且更大模型的仓库评估通过率从52.48%上升到58.54%。但这些证据依赖于拥有足够GPU、能组成可用单元的大型集群；预算明显更小的情况并未测试。作者还发现，将轨迹上限设为5条时，分数与使用全部路径相近，同时平均前向和反向时间减少了25.2%。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader implication is that agent training systems need to account for the execution harness, not only the policy and its objective. Qwen Gyre’s proxy observes model requests without requiring the harness to be rewritten, while its trajectory records preserve provenance and branching. This complements work on context management, such as Compaction R-L, by tackling the systems problem of turning long, changing executions into efficient online training.
segments.zh: 更广泛的意义在于，智能体训练系统需要把执行框架纳入考量，而不只是关注策略及其目标。Qwen Gyre 的代理无需重写执行框架即可观测模型请求，同时其轨迹记录保留了来源和分支信息。这与上下文管理方面的工作（如 Compaction R-L）形成互补，共同解决将漫长且不断变化的执行过程转化为高效在线训练这一系统性问题。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this connect to Polar, and what should researchers test next?
segments.zh: 这和Polar有什么联系，研究人员接下来应该测试什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Polar also uses a proxy to train through an existing harness, so both efforts treat the harness as part of the practical training problem. Qwen Gyre adds elastic movement between rollout and training, alongside bounded, deduplicated branch processing. Important next steps include testing smaller hardware budgets, measuring how streaming sample order affects learning, and improving reliable evaluators for partial work. The framework’s gains matter most where rollout variance and branching account for substantial training cost.
segments.zh: Polar 同样借助一个代理，通过现有的测试框架来训练，所以这两项工作都把测试框架视为实际训练问题的一部分。Qwen Gyre 在轨迹和训练之间加入了弹性调度，同时配合有界、去重的分支处理。接下来重要的步骤包括测试更小的硬件预算、衡量流式样本顺序对学习的影响，以及改进对部分工作的可靠评估器。这个框架的收益在轨迹方差和分支占据大量训练成本时最为显著。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The takeaway is that long-horizon agents create a systems challenge as much as a modeling challenge. Qwen Gyre coordinates live execution, changing G-P-U roles, and carefully reconstructed training data so that long tasks need not leave large parts of a cluster waiting. Its approach is most relevant when agents run for hours and produce branching histories. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 结论是，长时程智能体带来的既是建模挑战，也是系统挑战。Qwen Gyre 协调实时执行、不断变化的GPU角色以及精心重建的训练数据，使长任务不必让集群的大片资源空等。当智能体运行数小时并产生分支历史时，它的方法最为适用。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以询问我们的AI助手或留言评论。
